provenance.note: Weights listed above are the APPROVED product weights, which is not the same as the upstream named instances.
provenance.Space Grotesk 600: An approved NubArca product weight. Space Grotesk publishes no SemiBold: its named instances are Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500 and Bold 700, and its STAT table carries no Axis Value at 600. The 600 face is generated as a static instance at wght=600 from the official Google Fonts variable binary, whose wght axis is continuous over 300-700 and designed to be interpolated. Provenance and SHA-256 are mandatory and live in mobile/assets/fonts/fonts-manifest.json. The visible weight is NOT to be moved to 500 or 700 to match an upstream name.
